posts.text: Sorry you feel that way.   Two people below you believes I am “in the tank” for the President — I’ll just cover the news.  Thanks for watching

TONIGHT: Please tune in tonight 6pmEST for @specialreport. Ill sit down with new @dhsgov Secretary Markwayne Mullin. We will cover a host of topics, including his first weeks on the job, ending the government shutdown and threats to the homeland amidst the Iran war. #foxnews #specialreport

Senator Lindsey Graham explains the rationale behind President Trumps confrontational rhetoric toward Iranian leadership #iran #specialreport
NASA’s Artemis II crew is approximately on hour away from a 24,000 mph reentry and splashdown off the coast of San Diego #artemisii #nasa #specialreport
The DOJ and the FCC are investigating the NFL for potential anti-competitive practices amid surging costs for fans. #nfl #news #specialreport
I was joined by Jim Gray live from Augusta National, where Rory McIlroy looks to defend his title and Scottie Scheffler remains a top threat. #masters #golf
Some behind the scenes from my interview with @Senator Markwayne Mullin  #behindthescenes #interview #dhs

🚨BREAKING: “I agree to suspend the bombing and attack of Iran for a period of two weeks” Major breaking development as @President Donald J Trump announces a 14-day doubled-sided ceasefire and a workable 10-point peace proposal following a request from Pakistan’s Prime Minister #breaking #breakingnews #ceasefire #iran

It’s Tuesday, that means #tiktoktuesday, submit whatever questions you may have had in the comments or even stitch this video and ask your question. I’ll answer them on air tonight! Thank you @Trey Yingst for letting me use one of your videos as an example of how to stitch #tiktok #question
The DHS reports nearly 3 million deportations and self-deportations since the start of President Trumps term. @Senator Markwayne Mullin urges those in the U.S. illegally to self deport.
@Senator Markwayne Mullin shares the story behind his double name and the infamous red ball. Thank you for having me!  #dhs #interview
Tonight Markwayne Mullin will be joining me for his first interview as DHS Secretary on #specialreport at 6PM ET on @Fox News
